I see - the fuzzer uses `zend_first_try` / `zend_end_try` which catches errors via longjmp. When `zend_error_noreturn` is called with `E_COMPILE_ERROR`, it calls `zend_error_va_list` which calls `zend_error_cb`. The default error callback for compile errors will longjmp back to the `zend_first_try` point.
